operations.label: Click Document Link (exact match)
operations.summary: Document link matching a doc number EXACTLY (anchored regex); clicks .first() because both Document# and Document Title columns expose the number.
operations.note: Anchored regex ^\s*<docId>\s*$ prevents substring collisions (search '414' returns 4140-4149); clicks .first()

operations.label: All pending document links in the Action List
operations.summary: Enumerates every bare-number link in the Action List (one per pending document row) for reading the full set of pending doc numbers.
operations.note: NEEDS LIVE VERIFICATION — derived from docLink pattern; not yet confirmed against a live Action List. Read-only; never opens or mutates a document.

operations.label: Click Action List Menu Item
operations.summary: "Action List" menu item in the Kuali Build nav.

operations.label: Click Action List Search GO
operations.summary: Submits the Action List search filter; the only "GO" button on the page.

operations.label: Fill Action List Search Filter
operations.summary: Textbox for filtering the Action List by document number; scoped to the .kp-input-group containing the GO button.
operations.note: Scoped to .kp-input-group:has(.kp-input-button-right) to avoid the global nav search box

operations.label: Action List search box (scrape)
operations.summary: Read current filter value from the Action List search textbox.
operations.note: Same scoping as fill variant — `.kp-input-group:has(.kp-input-button-right)`.

operations.label: Department combobox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read currently selected department from the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Select Department in Final Transactions
operations.summary: Department combobox in the Final Transactions section.
operations.note: selectOption({ index }) not { label } — live UCSD options have irregular internal whitespace that breaks exact label match (ISS-B05). pickDepartmentOptionIndex() does 2-tier case-insensitive match

operations.label: Fill Payroll Title
operations.summary: Payroll Title textbox in the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Payroll Title textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read payroll title from the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Fill Payroll Title Code
operations.summary: Payroll Title Code textbox in the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Payroll Title Code textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read payroll title code from the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Fill Termination Effective Date
operations.summary: Termination Effective Date textbox in the Final Transactions section.
operations.note: Direct .fill() with 5s timeout; NOT fillWithVerify (no retry needed for this field)

operations.label: Termination Effective Date textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read termination effective date from the Final Transactions section.

operations.label: Click Save (navbar)
operations.summary: Save button with a 3-deep fallback chain: action-bar Save → nav Save → generic role Save.
operations.note: IRREVERSIBLE WRITE. 3-deep .or() chain: action-bar → nav → generic role button. Scrolls to top first. Waits for networkidle (critical for batch mode)

operations.label: EID textbox (fill)
operations.summary: Employee ID textbox on the Kuali separation form.

operations.label: Scrape EID
operations.summary: Read employee EID from the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: May have leading whitespace — .trim() applied; schema allows 5+ digits (lenient) so short EIDs reach identity-check gate

operations.label: Correct Employee Name in Kuali (similar branch)
operations.summary: Employee last name, first name textbox on the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Only on 'similar' tier. Writes to UNSUBMITTED Kuali draft even in dry-run (like timekeeper fill). correctNameSpelling preserves Last,First format and swaps only the misspelled token

operations.label: Scrape Employee Name
operations.summary: Read employee last name, first name from the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Raw value is ALL-CAPS (e.g. 'NAKAGAWA,MATTHEW K'); normalized to 'Last, First M' via displayPersonName() before stamping ctx.data

operations.label: Write Back Last Day Worked (conditional)
operations.summary: Last Day Worked date textbox on the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Only when ldwChanged (Kronos last punch ≠ Kuali LDW). Live runs only (dry-run terminal exits before this). fillWithVerify: fill → readback → retry with pressSequentially if dropped

operations.label: Scrape Last Day Worked
operations.summary: Read Last Day Worked date from the Kuali separation form.

operations.label: Location textbox (fill)
operations.summary: Optional Location textbox on the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Optional field — 3s timeout, silent failure if absent.

operations.label: Scrape Location (optional)
operations.summary: Read location value from the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Optional — 3s timeout, silent failure on missing field

operations.label: Write Back Separation Date (conditional)
operations.summary: Separation Date textbox on the Kuali separation form; matched via regex /Separation Date/.
operations.note: Only when separationDateChanged (derived sep date ≠ Kuali sep date). Live only. Audit comment added in kuali-finalization

operations.label: Scrape Separation Date
operations.summary: Read Separation Date from the Kuali separation form.

operations.label: Scrape Termination Type
operations.summary: Read the currently selected termination type from the Kuali separation form.
operations.note: Read via .evaluate() to get visible text (not internal value). Used by isVoluntaryTermination() and mapReasonCode()

operations.label: Type of Termination combobox (select)
operations.summary: Type of Termination combobox on the Kuali separation form.

operations.label: Check Request Acknowledged
operations.summary: Request Acknowledged - In Progress checkbox in the Timekeeper Tasks section.
operations.note: Runs in parallel with New Kronos timecard fetch via ctx.parallel

operations.label: Fill Timekeeper/Approver Comments
operations.summary: Timekeeper/Approver Comments textbox in the Timekeeper Tasks section.
operations.note: fillTimekeeperComments: reads existing field value + prepends it (append-aware). dateChangeComments = LDW audit line + sep-date audit line (if changed). comments = edit-resume override + dup-termination note (if approved reuse)

operations.label: Timekeeper/Approver Comments textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read timekeeper/approver comments from the Timekeeper Tasks section.

operations.label: Fill Timekeeper Name
operations.summary: Timekeeper Name textbox in the Timekeeper Tasks section.
operations.note: getTimekeeperName() from config (TIMEKEEPER_NAME env var). Also runs on kronos-skip path (non-HDH / prefill / preset) in a try/catch best-effort block

operations.label: Timekeeper Name textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read timekeeper name from the Timekeeper Tasks section.

operations.label: Select Does Not Need Final Pay (student employee)
operations.summary: "Does not need Final Pay (student employee)" radio button in the UCPath Transaction Results section.
operations.accessibleName: Does not need Final Pay (student employee)
operations.note: Hardcoded — assumes all UCSD separations are student employees
operations.literalValue: Does not need Final Pay (student employee)

operations.label: Check Submitted Termination Template
operations.summary: Submitted Termination Template checkbox in the UCPath Transaction Results section.

operations.label: Verify Transaction Number Still Filled Before Save
operations.note: verifyTxnNumberFilled: 300ms settle wait, readback, re-fill once if wrong, THROW if second mismatch. Kuali reactive bindings can reset the field after other fills

operations.label: Fill Transaction Number
operations.summary: Transaction Number textbox in the UCPath Transaction Results section.
operations.note: fillWithVerify: fill → readback → retry with pressSequentially. Skipped if empty (left blank for manual entry)

operations.label: Transaction Number textbox (scrape)
operations.summary: Read transaction number from the UCPath Transaction Results section.
